views.title: BABA Fixture Downloads · 3000K
views.intro: The "Order as" number swaps the 3000K / 70 CRI option into the DOT-listed configuration. None of these 3000K catalog numbers is listed by TxDOT as written (TxDOT qualified the 4000K versions), so ask the manufacturer to confirm the 3000K build carries the same Buy America certification before you specify it.

views.title: BABA Fixture Downloads · 4000K (as TxDOT lists)
views.intro: These are the 480V configurations exactly as TxDOT lists them, so the catalog numbers match the Compliant v5 listing with no substitutions. Photometry is the manufacturer's 4000K file for the same configuration.
